blocks.text: Gate 4C — English Concept and Sense Index 1.0
Exact canonical coverage: 324/324 atoms and 28/28 compounds
Next gate after release: Gate 4D coverage and ambiguity analysis

An English surface form is not itself a language meaning. Every indexed reading is a separate sense record that routes to exactly one canonical atom, one approved compound, future grammar, future semantic IR, or an explicit unsupported gap. Exact canonical labels are controlled inputs. Polysemous everyday words require context, a supplied sense, ranking, or clarification; file order must never choose meaning.
• send separates active communicative expression (CON:101) from active target data transfer (DAT:111).
• receive separates participant uptake (CON:111) from completed target data transfer (DAT:110).
• change separates material, mental, structural, and data transformations; domain-unspecified change routes to semantic IR.
• exist separates persistent distinct-existence (ORI:010) from completed distinct actualization (ORI:110).
• run separates locomotion, program execution, and machine operation; these require later occurrence-level IR.
• past and future route to reference-time IR and must not be confused with completed, pending, or latent lexical third-trit values.

Explicit gaps include chemical water, nutritive food, socially conventional friendship, safety thresholds, truth values, generic cognition, possession, and the physical and affective senses of home. These readings must produce unsupported-meaning results rather than nearest-neighbor guesses.
